title: Beam-Driven Active Plasma Dechirper for Energy Stabilization of High-Charge Bunches
summary: Plasma-based accelerators offer ultrahigh electric field gradients, yet delivering high-charge bunches with simultaneously low energy jitter and narrow energy spread remains a critical challenge. We propose a beam-driven active plasma dechirper integrated with a magnetic chicane to suppress both imperfections. By operating in the blowout regime at low plasma density, the dechirper accommodates a stretched witness bunch, thereby mitigating beam-loading effects and preserving the linear slope of the longitudinal wakefield for precise energy stabilization. Furthermore, a tailored initial energy chirp is introduced to reconcile the disparate optimal plasma lengths required for correcting jitter and spread. Three-dimensional simulations demonstrate that for a 1~GeV, 1~nC electron bunch, this scheme simultaneously reduces the energy jitter and spread from $\pm2$\% and 1\% to $\pm0.05$\% and 0.05\%, respectively, while maintaining nearly 100\% transmission.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种由束流驱动主动等离子体去啁啾器与磁 chicane 组成的方案，用于同时抑制等离子体加速中高电荷束流的能量抖动和能散；三维模拟显示，对 1 GeV、1 nC 电子束可将能量抖动与能散由 ±2% 和 1% 降至 ±0.05% 和 0.05%，并保持近 100% 传输。
AI.motivation: 等离子体加速器具有超高电场梯度，但如何同时获得高电荷、低能量抖动和窄能散束流仍是关键挑战，本文旨在解决这一双重限制。
AI.method: 采用束流驱动的主动等离子体去啁啾器并集成磁 chicane；在低等离子体密度下以 blowout 区运行，以容纳被拉伸的见证束，从而减轻束流负载效应并保持纵向尾场线性斜率以实现能量稳定；同时引入定制初始能量啁啾，以协调修正能量抖动和能散所需的不同最佳等离子体长度，并用三维模拟评估。
AI.result: 三维模拟表明，对于 1 GeV、1 nC 电子束，该方案将能量抖动和能散分别从 ±2% 和 1% 同时降低至 ±0.05% 和 0.05%，同时保持接近 100% 的传输率。
AI.conclusion: 该方案可同时抑制能量抖动和能散并维持高传输率，为等离子体加速器提供高质量高电荷束流给出可行途径；摘要未提供实验验证及更具体的装置参数。

title: Residual diffusion for fine-structure enhancement in low-count accelerator-based muon imaging
summary: Accelerator-based muon imaging combines the penetrating power of high-energy muons with selectable momentum and a controlled beam direction, offering a powerful means of probing internal structures in large, dense and heavily shielded objects. Within a fixed beam-time budget, realizing this potential requires reliable recovery of fine structures from limited muon statistics. We propose an observation-conditioned residual diffusion method with decoupled linear schedules to enhance low-count muon images through iterative restoration guided by the observed image. We evaluate a simplified VSC-24 fuel cask under an idealized 5 GeV parallel muon beam, using 500,000 accepted events per low-count image and 40 million per reference image. Simulation results show improved recovery of structural boundaries and fine details, with the mean peak signal-to-noise ratio increasing from 11.4239 to 22.1719 dB. These findings highlight the potential of diffusion models to make more effective use of limited muon data and broaden the application of accelerator-based muon imaging across scientific and industrial settings.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种观测条件残差扩散方法，利用解耦线性调度从有限μ子统计中恢复低计数μ子图像细节，并在简化VSC-24燃料桶仿真中验证其提升效果。
AI.motivation: 加速器μ子成像兼具高能μ子穿透能力、可选动量和可控束流方向，适合探测大型、致密且重屏蔽物体的内部结构；但在固定束流时间预算下，需从有限μ子统计中可靠恢复精细结构。
AI.method: 提出观测条件残差扩散方法，采用解耦线性调度，并通过由观测图像引导的迭代恢复增强低计数μ子图像；在理想化5 GeV平行μ子束下评估简化VSC-24燃料桶，低计数图像每幅使用50万个接受事件，参考图像使用4000万个接受事件。
AI.result: 仿真结果显示结构边界和精细细节恢复得到改善，平均峰值信噪比由11.4239 dB提升至22.1719 dB。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明扩散模型有潜力更有效地利用有限μ子数据，并拓展加速器μ子成像在科学和工业场景中的应用。

title: Time-Varying Bayesian Optimization and Extremum Seekingfor Drift-Tube Linac Tuning at LANSCE
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) has emerged as a promising machine learning approach to accelerator tuning. It has the advantage of being able to incorporate prior information, including simulation and historical data, and explicitly model measurement noise. However, standard implementations can produce large, abrupt parameter updates that are undesirable and potentially unsafe in accelerator operation. They may also spend excessive time exploring less promising regions of the search space. We address these limitations by imposing soft and hard step size limits. We evaluate these methods by adjusting the radio frequency settings of the drift tube linac (DTL) at the Los Alamos Neutron Science Center (LANSCE) to maximize the particle count at the end of the linac. We first test the methods in simulation with constant exogenous parameters, then repeat the tests with drifting exogenous parameters. Under drifting conditions, progressively reducing the BO step size limit improved convergence. We also find that an initial BO segment followed by extremum seeking (ES), an approach we call BO-ES, combines BO's use of prior information and sample efficiency with ES's effectiveness in local optimization and drift tracking. Finally, tests on the LANSCE accelerator with BO-ES demonstrate an approximately $25\%$ reduction in losses at the end of the linac across different configurations of historical and simulation data.

AI.tldr: 该文针对加速器调优中贝叶斯优化（BO）可能产生大幅突变参数、探索低潜力区域过多的问题，引入软/硬步长限制，并在LANSCE漂移管直线加速器（DTL）上以末端粒子数为目标评估；进一步提出先BO后极值搜索（ES）的BO-ES方法。结果表明，漂移条件下逐步减小BO步长限制可改善收敛，BO-ES兼顾先验信息利用、样本效率、局部优化与漂移跟踪，并在不同历史/仿真数据配置下使直线加速器末端损失约降低25%。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯优化可用于加速器调优，并能利用仿真与历史数据等先验信息、显式建模测量噪声；但标准实现可能产生大幅、突变且不理想甚至不安全的参数更新，还可能在搜索空间中较无希望的区域耗费过多时间。因此作者希望解决这些限制，提高加速器调优的安全性与收敛效率。
AI.method: 作者对贝叶斯优化施加软步长限制和硬步长限制；以Los Alamos Neutron Science Center（LANSCE）漂移管直线加速器（DTL）的射频设置为调节对象，以直线加速器末端粒子数为优化目标。先在恒定外生参数下进行仿真测试，再在漂移外生参数下重复测试；并测试先运行一个初始BO阶段、随后采用极值搜索（ES）的BO-ES方法。最后在LANSCE加速器上测试BO-ES，并考察不同历史数据与仿真数据配置。
AI.result: 在漂移条件下，逐步减小BO步长限制改善了收敛。BO-ES结合了BO对先验信息的使用和样本效率，以及ES在局部优化和漂移跟踪方面的有效性。LANSCE加速器上的BO-ES测试显示，在不同历史与仿真数据配置下，直线加速器末端损失约降低25%。
AI.conclusion: 软/硬步长限制可缓解标准BO产生大幅突变参数和低效探索的问题，逐步收紧步长限制有助于漂移条件下的收敛；BO-ES是一种有效的组合策略，并在LANSCE实验中显著降低末端损失。摘要未提供步长限制的具体数值、ES参数、实验时长及统计不确定性等细节。

title: Probing the Nuclear E2 Transition Amplitude in $^{229}$Th via Quantum Interference
summary: The nuclear E2 transition amplitude of $^{229}$Th probes nuclear deformation and configuration mixing, yet remains poorly constrained by measurements dominated by M1 radiation. We propose to determine its magnitude and sign relative to the nuclear M1 transition amplitude through quantum interference in $^{229}$Th$^{3+}$. Two coherent laser fields couple a superposition of initial hyperfine states to a common nuclear isomeric state through the electronic shell. Varying the mixing angle controls interference between the excitation pathways, allowing the signed E2/M1 transition amplitude ratio to be extracted using the calibrated laser-field amplitude ratio, without absolute intensity calibration. An independent M1 reference then determines the E2 magnitude. Dynamical calculations support the feasibility of the scheme, predicting appreciable nuclear excitation with milliwatt laser power on millisecond timescales. We evaluate the extraction sensitivity to experimental and atomic-structure uncertainties. The approach extends to other $^{229}$Th ions, whose rich level structures offer a broader selection of transitions and promising routes to suppress systematic uncertainties.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在$^{229}$Th$^{3+}$中利用双激光场诱导的量子干涉，测定核E2跃迁振幅相对于M1振幅的大小与符号；动力学计算支持该方案可行，并评估了提取灵敏度。
AI.motivation: $^{229}$Th的核E2跃迁振幅可探测核形变与组态混合，但现有测量主要由M1辐射主导，对其约束不足。
AI.method: 用两束相干激光场经电子壳层将初始超精细态叠加耦合到共同核同质异能态，通过改变混合角控制激发路径间干涉；利用已校准的激光场振幅比提取带符号的E2/M1跃迁振幅比，无需绝对强度校准，再用独立的M1参考确定E2大小。
AI.result: 动力学计算支持方案可行性，预测在毫瓦激光功率和毫秒时间尺度下可实现可观的核激发；作者评估了提取结果对实验不确定性和原子结构不确定性的灵敏度。
AI.conclusion: 该方案可用于确定$^{229}$Th的E2/M1振幅比及E2大小，并可推广到其他$^{229}$Th离子；其丰富能级结构可提供更多跃迁选择，并有望抑制系统误差。

title: Sub-Doppler Cooling of Potassium-41 in a Hybrid Quadrupole-Octupole Symmetry Magneto-Optical Trap
summary: Sub-Doppler cooling processes rely on the near-degeneracy of the Zeeman sub-levels of the atom. Effective sub-Doppler cooling is only achieved when the ac-Stark shift of the molasses light is significantly larger than the Zeeman shift. This condition is typically achieved by switching off all magnetic gradients, and using Helmholtz coils to cancel Earth's magnetic field. Another way to achieve a nearly zero magnetic field gradient is to superimpose a second pair of oppositely oriented quadrupole coils with a different spatial geometry. At the ideal current ratio, this creates an octupole-symmetry magnetic field for the atoms. The resulting octupole magnetic field has a gradient increasing quadratically from zero at the center. In this work, the effectiveness of sub-Doppler cooling and trapping using D2 and D1 light is evaluated in such a hybrid trap for $^{41}$K. The temperature, lifetime, and phase-space density of the atoms are measured. For both D2 and D1 light, the octupole MOT is found to have a longer lifetime, while maintaining a similar temperature to the zero-field case. D1 gray-molasses temperatures down to $3.8(1)~μ$K and phase-space density up to $5.3(4)\times10^{-5}$ are measured for $14.3(1)\times10^6$ $^{41}$ atoms. The effectiveness of the hybrid quadrupole-octupole trap suggests the possibility of increasing the loading time for atoms into an optical dipole trap with active sub-Doppler cooling.

AI.tldr: 在41K中评估由四极-八极混合磁场实现的近零梯度亚多普勒冷却与囚禁：D2和D1光下八极MOT寿命更长、温度与零场情形相近；D1灰糖蜜达到3.8(1) μK温度和5.3(4)×10^-5相空间密度。
AI.motivation: 亚多普勒冷却要求莫拉斯光的ac-Stark位移显著大于塞曼位移，通常需关闭所有磁场梯度并用亥姆霍兹线圈抵消地磁场；本文探索通过叠加反向四极线圈形成八极对称磁场来实现近零梯度，并评估其用于41K亚多普勒冷却与囚禁的可行性。
AI.method: 将第二对空间几何不同、方向相反的四极线圈与原有四极线圈叠加，在理想电流比下产生中心梯度为零、梯度随距离二次增长的八极磁场；在该混合四极-八极阱中使用D2和D1光对41K进行亚多普勒冷却与囚禁，并测量原子温度、寿命和相空间密度。
AI.result: 对D2和D1光，八极MOT均比零场情形寿命更长且温度相近；D1灰糖蜜冷却测得温度低至3.8(1) μK，相空间密度达5.3(4)×10^-5，对应14.3(1)×10^6个41K原子。摘要未给出具体寿命数值及光偶极阱装载时间测量。
AI.conclusion: 混合四极-八极阱可有效实现41K的亚多普勒冷却与囚禁，并提示可在保持主动亚多普勒冷却的情况下延长原子装载到光偶极阱的时间；该潜在装载时间增益尚未在摘要中给出实验数据。

title: Residual Allan Stability under Periodic Auxiliary Ramsey Sampling
comment: 23 pages in total, including 7 pages of Supplemental Material. 6 main figures, 2 tables, and 1 supplemental figure. Code and numerical data accompany the manuscript
summary: The timing of auxiliary Ramsey measurements can change the frequency stability associated with a drifting pulse shift at a fixed nominal Fisher-information rate for a constant shift. For periodic instantaneous observations of an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck shift with causal prediction between updates, we derive the exact residual covariance averaged over the update cycle and the corresponding Allan variance at arbitrary averaging times. Relative to a continuous Kalman reference at the same information rate, periodic estimation increases the cycle-averaged estimation-error variance, reduces the short-time residual Allan variance, and increases its long-time value. Its covariance decays more slowly at the origin and has a larger integral. We extend the result to instantaneous sensing of the sum of finitely many independent Ornstein-Uhlenbeck modes. Integrated observations preserve the short-time ordering for the scalar shift, and numerical calculations resolve the dependence of the crossover on window duration. A zero-order-hold comparison shows that the short-time ordering can change when the same estimator drives a different correction command. A three-level Ramsey model of coherent population trapping (CPT) maps the discriminator response to an effective information budget and illustrates how the dark times affect the choice of schedule.

AI.tldr: 该文分析在固定标称 Fisher 信息率下，辅助 Ramsey 测量的时序如何改变漂移脉冲偏移所对应的频率稳定度；核心是周期估计相对连续 Kalman 参考在短期与长期 Allan 方差上的权衡。
AI.motivation: 研究在恒定偏移和固定信息率下，Ramsey 测量的调度方式（周期瞬时观测及更新间因果预测）如何影响 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 漂移的估计与 Allan 方差，并与连续 Kalman 参考进行比较。
AI.method: 针对带因果预测的周期瞬时观测，推导更新周期平均的精确残差协方差及任意平均时间下的 Allan 方差；与同信息率的连续 Kalman 参考比较；推广到有限个独立 OU 模式之和；分析积分观测，并用数值计算确定交叉点与窗口时长的关系；进行零阶保持比较；建立三能级 Ramsey CPT 模型，将鉴别器响应映射为有效信息预算。
AI.result: 相对连续 Kalman 参考，周期估计提高周期平均估计误差方差，降低短期残余 Allan 方差但提高其长期值；其协方差在原点衰减更慢且积分更大。对有限个独立 OU 模式之和，积分观测在标量偏移情形保持短期排序；数值计算给出交叉点对窗口时长的依赖。零阶保持比较表明，同一估计器驱动不同校正命令时短期排序可能改变。CPT 模型显示暗时间会影响调度选择。
AI.conclusion: 辅助 Ramsey 测量的时序会在固定信息率下改变频率稳定性的时间尺度结构，形成短期与长期性能权衡；调度选择应结合观测窗口、校正命令以及 CPT 暗时间对应的有效信息预算。

title: Squeezed Cooling and Lasing with Cold Atoms in Cavity-QED
comment: 27 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables. Main text with Methods, followed by Supplementary Information
summary: A squeezed laser undergoes a lasing transition into a squeezed cavity mode, where stimulated emission generates a bright coherent field with a laser-like coherence time while maintaining one field quadrature below the vacuum noise level. Here we propose an optical implementation that needs neither a nonlinear crystal nor injected squeezed light, based on engineered interactions between ensembles of rubidium atoms and a squeezed cavity mode via cavity-assisted Raman transitions. A first ensemble cools the cavity into a squeezed vacuum, a mechanism we term squeezed cooling, yielding up to 9 dB in the intracavity field, surpassing the 3 dB limit of optical parametric oscillators. Tuned for output instead, it reaches up to 18 dB of output squeezing. Incoherently pumping a second ensemble drives a lasing transition into the squeezed mode, emitting a bright beam with long coherence time and noise below vacuum spanning a megahertz-wide band, away from the sharp phase-diffusion peak of excess noise at the carrier frequency, and robust to relaxation oscillations. We characterize lasing thresholds, superradiant emission, and linewidth narrowing, and identify the experimentally accessible regime where the system exhibits the defining features of a squeezed laser.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需非线性晶体或注入压缩光的压缩激光方案：利用铷原子系综与压缩腔模的腔辅助拉曼跃迁，先通过“压缩冷却”制备压缩腔场，再驱动进入压缩腔模的激光转变；给出最高9 dB腔内压缩、18 dB输出压缩，并刻画激光阈值、超辐射和线宽窄化。
AI.motivation: 压缩激光需要在保持激光式相干性的同时，使一个场正交分量低于真空噪声；已有实现通常依赖非线性晶体或注入压缩光。本文旨在基于原子系综与腔模的工程化相互作用，提供一种替代的光学实现方案。
AI.method: 基于铷原子系综与压缩腔模之间的腔辅助拉曼跃迁：第一个系综通过作者称为“压缩冷却”的机制将腔制备为压缩真空；第二个系综经非相干泵浦，驱动向压缩腔模的激光转变。文章分析腔内与输出压缩、激光阈值、超辐射发射、线宽窄化及噪声谱，并确定实验可及参数区域。摘要未提供具体实验参数，也未说明是否已完成实验验证。
AI.result: 第一个系综可实现最高9 dB的腔内场压缩，超过光学参量振荡器3 dB的压缩极限；针对输出优化时可达18 dB输出压缩。非相干泵浦第二个系综后，系统发射明亮光束，具有长相干时间，并在兆赫兹宽频带内保持噪声低于真空，避开载波频率处由相位扩散导致的尖锐过量噪声峰，同时对弛豫振荡稳健。文章还表征了激光阈值、超辐射发射和线宽窄化。
AI.conclusion: 该方案在无需非线性晶体和注入压缩光的条件下，给出了压缩激光的实现路径，并识别出能够展现压缩激光定义性特征的实验可及区域；摘要支持其作为可行理论提案，但未报告实际实验验证。

title: Rabi-Engineered spin-selective transport of bright soliton in a binary spin-1/2 condensate
summary: Spintronics is usually concentrated on spin-dependent dynamics of single particles such as electrons or holes in solids. Extending this concept to nonlinear matter waves offers an interesting possibility of controlling the transport of collective, particle-like excitations through their spin degrees of freedom. Recent advances in Bose-Einstein condensates have provided a versatile platform for realizing nonlinear spin-1/2 systems that support particle-like objects such as bright solitons, making studies of the motion of these solitons under external fields an interesting and important problem. Here, we study the dynamics of bright solitons with different spin symmetries moving in a coordinate-dependent Rabi field, which acts analogously to a spatially varying magnetic field. In that setup, the velocity perturbed soliton motion possesses very interesting scattering dynamics for both perfect and lifted Manakov symmetry. Lastly, we compare both the velocity-controlled scattering problem with the well-known Rabi quenching protocol. This comparison provides a powerful approach to control the soliton dynamics that may open an avenue to control nonlinear spintronics with solitons as spin carriers.

AI.tldr: 该文把单粒子自旋电子学拓展到非线性物质波，研究不同自旋对称性的亮孤子在坐标依赖Rabi场中的动力学，并比较速度控制散射与Rabi淬火协议，提出以孤子为自旋载流子的非线性自旋电子学控制思路。
AI.motivation: 传统自旋电子学多关注固体中电子或空穴等单粒子的自旋相关动力学；作者希望将这一概念推广到非线性物质波，通过自旋自由度控制集体、类粒子激发（如亮孤子）的输运。玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚为非线性自旋-1/2系统及亮孤子研究提供了平台，因此研究外场下亮孤子运动具有意义。
AI.method: 作者研究具有不同自旋对称性的亮孤子在坐标依赖Rabi场中的动力学；该Rabi场类比于空间变化的磁场。文中分析速度扰动后的孤子运动在完美Manakov对称性和lifted Manakov对称性下的散射动力学，并将速度控制的散射问题与已知的Rabi淬火协议进行比较。
AI.result: 摘要指出，速度扰动后的孤子运动在完美和lifted Manakov对称性下均表现出有趣的散射动力学；速度控制散射问题与Rabi淬火协议的比较为控制孤子动力学提供了有力途径。摘要未提供具体定量结果、参数范围或实验数据。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将亮孤子视为自旋载流子，提出通过坐标依赖Rabi场和速度控制散射并结合Rabi淬火协议来调控孤子动力学，可能为非线性自旋电子学开辟新的控制途径。

title: Quantum Mpemba effect in a driven-dissipative atom-waveguide coupled system
summary: The quantum Mpemba effect (QME) describes the counterintuitive phenomenon in which a more strongly perturbed quantum system relaxes toward its steady state faster than a less perturbed one. Here, we investigate the QME in a weakly driven-dissipative atomic array coupled to a one-dimensional chiral waveguide. Starting from the steady state, we introduce a local quench by resetting a single atom to its ground state and examine the subsequent relaxation dynamics. We find that quenching atoms near the array boundaries induces faster initial relaxation through enhanced coupling to superradiant modes and direct photon emission into the waveguide, giving rise to an edge-enhanced QME. Strong directional decay further amplifies this effect by promoting the spatial accumulation of superradiant modes near the preferred boundary, leading to a skin-enhanced QME. At later times, relaxation is increasingly governed by long-lived subradiant modes localized predominantly in the bulk of the array. By coupling two atomic arrays with different interparticle spacings, we further demonstrate an interface-induced QME, where quenching an atom near the interface makes the system relax more slowly at early times but approach its steady state faster at later times, owing to weak participation in both superradiant and subradiant modes. Our findings reveal how the spatial structure of collective decay modes and directional dissipation jointly govern anomalous quantum relaxation, offering potential routes toward accelerated steady-state preparation in waveguide QED systems.

title: Symmetry classification of hyperfine rovibrational molecular phase space
summary: Symmetry-based structures have advanced molecular spectroscopy and quantum information science, yet connections between these fields remain largely unexplored. We construct a phase space theory of a molecule by jointly treating rotational, vibrational, and nuclear-spin degrees of freedom as the quotient of orientations and normal coordinates by the molecule's point group. The various combinations of how these three degrees of freedom transform under symmetries organize a molecule's states into molecular species, and we show that each species is defined by a particular absolutely maximally entangled (AME) carrier state, or, for 45 species, by a two-dimensional space of them. Up to local unitaries and the order of the sectors, molecular species realize 21 AME states across 75 point groups: a product state, four maximally entangled pairs, and 16 genuinely tripartite states. A Fourier transform on the quotient relates orientation and angular-momentum descriptions while preserving these carrier states. We propose an example experimental protocol for preparing and driving symmetry-adapted bend states of $\mathrm{CaOCH_3}$.

title: Scalable Non-Parametric Bayesian Inference of Free Energy Landscapes and Emission Functions from Observations
summary: Free-energy landscapes govern processes from protein conformational change to climate oscillations, but are typically observed only indirectly, through observables such as FRET intensity or optical-tweezer transmittance. Neither the landscape shape, nor the emission function mapping latent state to signal, is usually known, and distinct states may produce the same signal. We therefore infer landscape and emission function jointly and non-parametrically, using the exact non-linear Bayesian filtering likelihood, to fully use the information contained in observable trajectories that are often noisy, scarce and costly to acquire. A novel parallel-in-time algorithm makes this tractable: it is up to 27 times faster than sequential filtering on one GPU, scales near-ideally across GPUs, and, given enough resources, has runtime independent of trajectory length. We demonstrate the method on a single-protein optical tweezer recording, where distinct conformations produce the same signal, and beyond biology on the El Nino-Southern Oscillation and financial market volatility.

AI.tldr: 该文提出联合、非参数化推断自由能景观与发射函数的方法，利用精确非线性贝叶斯滤波似然充分提取含噪、稀缺且昂贵的可观测轨迹信息，并用新型时间并行算法提升计算可行性；在单蛋白光镊记录、厄尔尼诺-南方涛动和金融市场波动率数据上进行了演示。
AI.motivation: 自由能景观支配从蛋白质构象变化到气候振荡等过程，但通常只能通过FRET强度或光镊透射率等观测量间接观测。景观形状及从潜在状态到信号的发射函数通常未知，且不同状态可能产生相同信号。因此需要联合推断景观与发射函数，并充分利用含噪、稀缺、获取成本高的轨迹信息。

title: The state of nuclear data for fusion activation simulations
summary: This report compares decay-heat calculations made with four nuclear data libraries, TENDL-2025, ENDF/B-VIII.1, JEFF-4.0 and JENDL-5, against the JAEA FNS decay-heat benchmark. The main comparison uses the 2000 campaign, in which 73 foils were irradiated for five minutes in a mostly 14 MeV neutron field and their decay heat was measured for about an hour. The 1996 seven-hour campaign, with 29 foils and cooling times of up to 400 days, is compared separately and is not included in the rankings. Over the 69 elemental foils solved by all four libraries, the median deviation from the measurement (the mean absolute C/E deviation of each foil) is JENDL-5 17 percent, TENDL-2025 19 percent, JEFF-4.0 22 percent and ENDF/B-VIII.1 44 percent. No library is best everywhere: JENDL-5 on 24, JEFF-4.0 on 18, TENDL-2025 on 17 and ENDF/B-VIII.1 on 10 of the foils. For each element the report breaks the heat down by product and lists the nuclear data on which the libraries differ, and the final sections propose measurements, including enriched-isotope irradiations, that would resolve the largest differences.

AI.tldr: 该报告以JAEA FNS衰变热基准检验TENDL-2025、ENDF/B-VIII.1、JEFF-4.0和JENDL-5四个核数据库，主分析基于2000年73片箔5分钟辐照、约1小时衰变热测量；在四库均能计算的69个元素箔中，JENDL-5中位偏差最低（17%），但无数据库在所有箔上最优。
AI.motivation: 比较四种核数据 library 的衰变热计算结果与JAEA FNS基准测量，评估各库表现并识别导致差异的核数据，进而提出可解决最大差异的测量建议。
AI.method: 主比较采用2000年 campaign：73片箔在主要为14 MeV中子场中辐照5分钟，测量约1小时衰变热；1996年7小时 campaign（29片箔、冷却时间最长400天）单独比较且不纳入排名。对四个库均能求解的69个元素箔，以每个箔的平均绝对C/E偏差的中位数作为偏差指标；逐元素按产物分解衰变热并列出各库不同的核数据。
AI.result: 中位偏差为JENDL-5 17%、TENDL-2025 19%、JEFF-4.0 22%、ENDF/B-VIII.1 44%。没有库在所有箔上最优：JENDL-5在24个、JEFF-4.0在18个、TENDL-2025在17个、ENDF/B-VIII.1在10个箔上最优。报告还给出逐元素产物分解及库间核数据差异。
AI.conclusion: JENDL-5具有最低的总体中位偏差，但各库在不同元素箔上各有优势，不存在普遍最优的库；最终建议开展包括富集同位素辐照在内的测量，以解决最大的库间差异。

title: Mesh Sensitivity of Different Boundary Treatments in High-Order Compact Gas-Kinetic Scheme for Hypersonic Heat-Flux Prediction
summary: Accurate wall-heat-flux prediction in hypersonic flow depends on both the wall treatment and the available near-wall resolution. This work compares three complete implementations of a gas-kinetic scheme (GKS) for Mach~8.03 laminar flow over an isothermal circular cylinder: a linear Green--Gauss scheme (GG), a compact ghost-cell scheme (GC), and a pointwise one-sided compact scheme (POS). In POS, the stationary isothermal-wall conditions are imposed at the two Gaussian points used by the kinetic wall-flux quadrature. A reference mesh and six meshes in the uniform reduction (UR), log-layer unpacked (LLU), and log-layer packed (LLP) families are used to assess heat-flux sensitivity. At 24 digitized experimental angles, GG has the lowest root-mean-square difference on the reference, UR, and LLP families, whereas POS is closest on the two LLU meshes; GC is not the lowest-RMS scheme on any tested mesh. Hence no treatment is uniformly superior. On the present high-aspect-ratio cylinder grids, GG is the more robust choice except under LLU node redistribution, for which POS is preferable. Uniform reduction produces the largest heat-flux response for all three implementations. The comparison concerns complete schemes and does not isolate the pointwise constraints from differences in reconstruction and geometry representation.

AI.tldr: 本文在Mach 8.03层流等温圆柱绕流中比较三种完整的气体动理学格式（GG、GC、POS）对壁面热流的预测，并在参考网格及UR、LLU、LLP三类共六套网格上评估敏感性。结果表明没有一种格式在所有网格上占优：GG在参考网格、UR和LLP上RMS最低，POS在两套LLU网格上最接近实验，GC未在任何测试网格上取得最低RMS；均匀加密（UR）引起最大热流响应。
AI.motivation: 高超音速流动中的壁面热流预测精度取决于壁面处理方式与可用的近壁分辨率，因此需要比较不同完整气体动理学格式实现及其对网格族和近壁节点分布的敏感性。

AI.result: 在24个数字化实验角度上，GG在参考网格、UR和LLP网格族上的均方根差异最低，POS在两套LLU网格上最接近实验，GC未在任何测试网格上取得最低RMS。因此没有一种壁面处理在所有情形下统一占优。在当前高长宽比圆柱网格上，除LLU节点重分布情形外，GG是更稳健的选择；LLU下POS更优。均匀缩减（UR）对三种实现均产生最大的热流响应。
AI.conclusion: 三种完整GKS实现中不存在普遍最优的壁面处理；GG在高长宽比圆柱网格上整体更稳健，而LLU节点重分布下宜选POS。UR网格对热流最敏感。该比较针对完整格式，不能将逐点约束的影响与重构和几何表示差异区分开；摘要未提供具体误差数值。

title: Real-space electrostatic sums through truncation error analysis
summary: Methods that treat electrostatics in real space, without explicit reciprocal-space evaluation, are appealing for large-scale atomistic simulations. They typically employ local charge-neutralization schemes, but their relationship to the underlying error contributions of the full Ewald sum has not been fully characterized. A principled basis for parameter selection is also lacking. In this work, we show that the correction terms of Wolf's and Pickard's real-space methods approximate the truncation error of real-space electrostatic sums. This perspective motivates simplified fixed-radii and force-shifted Pickard variants that preserve the truncation-error compensation behavior while enforcing continuity of pair energy and force at the cutoff. We derive a nonempirical scaling relation for the optimal path in the parameter space of the cutoff radius and screening distance, generalizing Pickard's empirical heuristic and explaining when and why it can fail. A systematic scheme for restoring omitted reciprocal contributions is introduced, which accelerates convergence to the full Ewald energy.

AI.tldr: 该文指出 Wolf 和 Pickard 实空间静电方法的修正项可近似实空间静电求和的截断误差，并据此提出简化变体、非经验参数缩放关系及恢复倒空间贡献的系统方案，以改进大尺度原子模拟中的静电计算。
AI.motivation: 实空间静电方法因无需显式倒空间计算而适合大规模原子模拟，但此类方法多采用局部电荷中和方案，其与完整 Ewald 求和误差贡献之间的关系尚未充分表征，且缺乏有原则的参数选择依据。
AI.method: 作者从截断误差补偿的角度分析 Wolf 和 Pickard 实空间方法的修正项，提出固定半径和力移位的 Pickard 简化变体，在保持截断误差补偿行为的同时保证截断处 pair energy 和力的连续性；推导截断半径与屏蔽距离参数空间中优化路径的非经验缩放关系，并引入恢复被省略倒空间贡献的系统方案。
AI.result: 研究表明 Wolf 和 Pickard 方法的修正项近似实空间静电求和的截断误差；所提出的变体保持误差补偿并满足能量和力的连续性；导出的非经验缩放关系推广了 Pickard 的经验启发式，并能解释其何时及为何失效；恢复倒空间贡献的方案可加速收敛到完整 Ewald 能量。摘要未提供定量性能数据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为实空间静电方法提供了基于截断误差补偿的参数选择依据，改进了对 Pickard 经验规则的理解，并通过恢复倒空间贡献提升向完整 Ewald 能量的收敛性。摘要未给出具体数值结论或适用性边界。

title: Non-intrusive modal decomposition of transport-dominated data
summary: We derive a non-intrusive modal decomposition method for positive transport-dominated datasets. We derive our method by generalizing an optimization-centric formulation of the Proper Orthogonal Decomposition. We propose two principles as a basis for this generalization. The first is that the Wasserstein distance is a more effective measure of the approximation error for transport-dominated problems, and the second is that the smoothness of the low-dimensional trajectories must be taken into account during the reconstruction. The framework is sufficiently flexible that domain-expert knowledge, in the form of inequality constraints, can be easily included. These features are demonstrated on synthetic problems and on data from a wildland fire simulation. Our method is based on the Shifted POD, which models the data as the sum of modes undergoing different coordinate transformations, but unlike the bulk of Shifted POD literature we do not assume that the correct transformation parameters are known. For a fixed number of modes, we observe a reduction of the reconstruction error of up to $43\%$ with respect to the Shifted POD baseline, despite the fact that the baseline assumes a-priori knowledge of the coordinate transformation parameters and the proposed method does not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向正传输主导数据的非侵入式模态分解方法，通过推广以优化为中心的POD，引入Wasserstein距离与低维轨迹平滑性，并允许加入不等式约束；方法基于Shifted POD但不假定坐标变换参数已知，在合成问题和野外火灾模拟数据上取得最高43%的重建误差降低。
AI.motivation: 传输主导数据中，传统POD的重建误差度量与重构效果可能不理想；需要一种非侵入式模态分解方法，更好衡量传输主导问题的近似误差，在重建时考虑低维轨迹平滑性，并能灵活融入领域专家以不等式约束形式提供的知识，同时避免依赖已知的坐标变换参数。
AI.method: 推广以优化为中心的Proper Orthogonal Decomposition，提出两项原则：用Wasserstein距离作为传输主导问题更有效的近似误差度量，并在重建中考虑低维轨迹的平滑性；框架可加入不等式约束。方法基于Shifted POD，将数据建模为经历不同坐标变换的模态之和，但不假设正确的变换参数已知，而是从数据中处理这些参数。
AI.result: 在合成问题和野外火灾模拟数据上验证了方法。固定模态数时，相对于Shifted POD基线，重建误差最高降低43%；该基线假定坐标变换参数先验已知，而所提方法不依赖该先验知识。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法是一种灵活、非侵入式的模态分解框架，能够结合Wasserstein误差度量、轨迹平滑性和不等式约束，并在不假定变换参数已知的条件下优于Shifted POD基线。摘要未提供计算复杂度、理论保证或其他定量指标。

title: Consistent interfacial flow numerics - Part I: The gravity force term
summary: The OpenFOAM solver interFoam for incompressible two-phase flows combines the single-phase PISO/PIMPLE algorithm for the pressure-velocity coupling with an interface advection step. It relies on the standard finite volume discretisation of the momentum equation, which assumes smooth fields, but across a water-air interface the density jumps by a factor of about 1000. The geometric Volume-of-Fluid method isoAdvector, used in interIsoFoam, made the advection step consistent with a sharp interface, but spurious velocities near it remain due to the momentum discretisation. This series revisits it term by term. Here we treat the gravity term, which acts only at the interface and depends on the local interface height. Both solvers crudely assign this height using the face centre positions. We show that this is a key source of the spurious air velocities. Taking the height from the reconstructed interface instead gives an exact discrete balance between pressure and gravity for a horizontal interface on any mesh. We implement this geometric gravity model in a new solver, interIsoGoam. In a tilted box of still water, where the original solvers give air speeds of metres per second, it keeps the velocity of order $10^{-9}$ m/s. This holds for density ratios up to $10^7$ and, with a hydrostatic initial pressure, on skewed and locally refined meshes. In a progressive wave, interIsoGoam has the lowest maximum velocity of the three solvers. At maximum Courant numbers of 0.1 and below it therefore needs up to 43 % fewer steps and up to 38 % less wall-clock time. At 0.5 the wave grows by up to 12 % over 15 periods, so we recommend 0.1 or less. One error remains, namely an overprediction of the horizontal water velocity below the wave crest. All three solvers exhibit this error, which grows steadily with time. In Part II we trace this error to the implicit discretisation of the momentum convection term.

AI.tldr: 本文逐项审视 interFoam/interIsoFoam 的动量离散，重点修正界面处重力项的高度赋值：用重构界面高度替代面心高度，并在新求解器 interIsoGoam 中实现几何重力模型。静水与波浪测试表明其显著抑制虚假空气速度并减少计算步数和耗时，但仍存在波峰下水平水速高估。
AI.motivation: 标准有限体积动量离散假设场光滑，但水-气界面密度跳变约1000倍；isoAdvector 虽使界面推进尖锐，界面附近仍因动量离散产生虚假速度。本文针对仅在界面处作用且依赖局部界面高度的重力项，指出原求解器用面心位置粗估高度是虚假空气速度的关键来源。
AI.method: 从重构界面提取局部界面高度，替代基于面心位置的高度赋值，构造对水平界面在任意网格上实现压力与重力精确离散平衡的几何重力模型，并在新求解器 interIsoGoam 中实现。测试包括倾斜静水箱、密度比至10^7、静水初始压力下的偏斜与局部加密网格，以及渐进波，并与原求解器比较最大速度和计算成本。
AI.result: 倾斜静水箱中原求解器空气速度达米/秒量级，interIsoGoam 保持约10^-9 m/s；该性质在密度比至10^7及偏斜、局部加密网格上成立。渐进波中 interIsoGoam 的最大速度最低；最大Courant数不超过0.1时最多减少43%步数和38%墙钟时间；Courant数0.5时波在15个周期内增长至12%，故建议不超过0.1。仍存在波峰下水平水速度高估，且随时间增长，三种求解器均有此误差。
AI.conclusion: 采用重构界面高度的几何重力模型可消除静水界面处的虚假空气速度，并改善波浪模拟的效率，推荐最大Courant数不超过0.1。残余的波峰下水平水速度高估被归因于动量对流项的隐式离散，将在 Part II 进一步处理。

title: 4D-TEMPO: Differentiable 4D-STEM ptychography via fast Physics Optimizers
comment: 34 pages: 8-page paper, references, and 23-page supplementary material; 10 figures, 10 tables
summary: Electron ptychography recovers atomic structure from 4D-STEM data: diffraction patterns at multiple positions of a scanned probe. Current codes reconstruct an image and read atoms off it, or fit atoms under an $L_1$ loss; neither gives per-atom uncertainty. We propose 4D-TEMPO, a differentiable physical renderer that fits the atoms, the microscope, and the detector directly to the recorded electron counts under a Poisson likelihood. The output is a list of atoms, each a Gaussian primitive with a 3D position, a thermal width, and a model-conditional error bar from the Fisher information. The Fisher information also conditions the solver, gives the dose (electrons per Å$^2$) each parameter needs, and separates calibration from imaging. On a simulated WSe$_2$ bilayer, starting from the published reconstruction, fitted atoms cut in-plane error by a third (3.2 vs. 4.8 pm) and depth error by 40-61% against its 3D peaks. Depth comes from multiple scattering into the dark field, the faint counts outside the direct beam. The two layers, $10\times$ closer than the depth of field, separate; per-atom depth then follows the layer geometry. When the model is well specified, the bars are calibrated (69% of position coordinates within $1σ$). On experimental WSe$_2$, fitted atoms predict held-out patterns better than the three published codes we test. With free probe modes where atoms are incomplete, the same likelihood predicts best on all three held-out benchmarks, matches every WSe$_2$ baseline in 5 min against up to 20.5 h, and passes torchslice at its released setting 180$\times$ sooner on PrScO$_3$. Per-atom error bars, planned doses, and fast reconstruction point to low-dose, real-time 3D imaging of beam-sensitive and dynamic materials.

AI.tldr: 论文提出4D-TEMPO：一种可微物理渲染器，在泊松似然下将原子、显微镜和探测器直接拟合到4D-STEM电子计数，输出带Fisher信息误差棒的原子列表。在模拟与实验WSe$_2$及PrScO$_3$上，它提高了精度与速度，并支持低剂量、实时三维成像。
AI.motivation: 现有电子叠层成像通常先重建图像再读取原子，或在$L_1$损失下拟合原子，均不能给出逐原子不确定性；作者希望直接拟合记录到的电子计数，同时获得原子参数、校准量和可规划的剂量。
AI.method: 提出4D-TEMPO，将原子、显微镜和探测器作为可微模型直接拟合4D-STEM电子计数，采用泊松似然。输出为高斯原语表示的原子列表，每个原子含三维位置、热宽度及由Fisher信息给出的模型条件误差棒；Fisher信息还用于条件化求解器、计算各参数所需剂量，并分离校准与成像。
AI.result: 在模拟WSe$_2$双层上，从已发表重建出发，拟合原子将面内误差由4.8 pm降至3.2 pm（约减少三分之一），深度误差相对其三维峰值降低40-61%；两层间距比景深浅$10\times$仍可分离，逐原子深度遵循层几何。模型设定正确时，69%的位置坐标落在$1\sigma$内。实验WSe$_2$上，拟合原子对留出图案的预测优于所测三个已发表代码；在原子不完整且探针模式自由的条件下，同一似然在三个留出基准上预测最佳，5分钟内匹配所有WSe$_2$基线（基线最长20.5 h），并在PrScO$_3$上以180倍更短时间通过torchslice的发布设置。
AI.conclusion: 逐原子误差棒、可规划剂量和快速重建指向对束敏感及动态材料的低剂量、实时三维成像。

title: Electric combined-field-only P1 Galerkin BEM for PEC scattering with scalar Helmholtz operators
summary: We develop a Galerkin boundary element method for the indirect electric field-only combined-field integral equation (ECFOIE) for perfectly electrically conducting obstacles with smooth surfaces. The method is free of low-frequency breakdown and of spurious resonances. It applies scalar Helmholtz operators componentwise, so that fast scalar solvers can be reused, with less memory than a Rao-Wilton-Glisson (RWG) discretization. The iteration count of the Calderón-regularized ECFOIE (R-ECFOIE) is constant under mesh refinement and, with a complex-wavenumber Calderón regularizer, grows only mildly with frequency. The discretization uses continuous, nodal piecewise-linear basis functions on flat triangular meshes, with essentially as many unknowns as an RWG discretization, and tangential and normal projections and the mean curvature of the obstacle's surface carry the vector structure. On flat meshes the curvature is concentrated on the edges, and we average the edge measure obtained from the first variation of area over vertex patches, which gives sparse curvature matrices. At low frequency, four Lagrange-multiplier constraints on the induced charge and on the longitudinal dipole moments of the far field keep the R-ECFOIE accurate in the quasi-static regime, tested on scatterers eight orders of magnitude smaller than the wavelength. Under mesh refinement, the errors decrease at about second order. A Helmholtz resonator, a rounded Fichera cube, and a smoothed Stanford bunny are compared with electric field integral equation (EFIE) solutions, and the first two also with electrostatic references at extreme low frequency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对光滑理想导体目标的伽辽金边界元法，用于间接电场型组合场积分方程（ECFOIE）。该方法采用Calderón正则化、分量为标量Helmholtz算子、平坦三角形网格上的连续节点分片线性基函数，以及稀疏曲率矩阵和低频Lagrange乘子约束；实验表明其无低频崩溃和虚假共振，迭代数随网格细化保持常数，并在极端低频及多个基准目标上保持精度。
AI.motivation: 为克服电场型积分方程的低频崩溃和虚假共振问题，同时复用快速标量Helmholtz求解器、降低内存需求，并保持与RWG离散相当的未知量规模，作者发展了该伽辽金边界元方法。
AI.method: 采用伽辽金边界元法离散间接电场型组合场积分方程（ECFOIE），并使用Calderón正则化（R-ECFOIE）。方法将标量Helmholtz算子按分量作用，以复用快速标量求解器；离散采用平坦三角形网格上的连续节点分片线性基函数，通过切向/法向投影和表面平均曲率体现矢量结构。平坦网格上的曲率集中于边，作者将由面积一阶变分得到的边度量在顶点片上进行平均，从而得到稀疏曲率矩阵。低频时引入四个Lagrange乘子约束，分别约束感应电荷和远场纵向偶极矩。
AI.result: 该方法无低频崩溃和虚假共振；R-ECFOIE的迭代次数在网格细化下保持常数，采用复波数Calderón正则化时仅随频率缓慢增长。未知量数量与RWG离散基本相当，但内存更少。低频下可准确处理比波长小八个数量级的散射体；网格细化时误差约按二阶收敛。算例包括Helmholtz谐振器、圆角Fichera立方体和光滑化Stanford兔子，并与EFIE解比较，前两者还与极端低频静电解比较。摘要未给出具体误差数值或迭代次数数值。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在光滑理想导体散射问题上兼具无低频崩溃、无虚假共振、可复用快速标量求解器、较低内存和近二阶收敛等特性，并在极端低频及多个基准算例中表现出良好精度；具体定量性能数据未在摘要中提供。

title: Characterizing adsorption thermodynamics in carbon capture materials: an efficient first-principles approach
comment: Main: 12 pages, 6 figures. SI: 19 pages, 13 figures
summary: Porous materials offer a vast design space for CO$_2$ capture, whose exploration hinges on efficient and accurate first-principles predictions of the thermodynamics governing adsorption. However, simulating isotherms and heats of adsorption using grand canonical molecular simulations is extremely computationally expensive when combined with accurate ab initio treatments of the molecular interactions, limiting screening to low-pressure uptake encoded in the Henry constant. Identifying and designing the best CO$_2$ capture materials requires a strategy that can efficiently calculate their adsorption properties using ab initio potential energy surfaces such as those now available from foundational machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs). Here we develop a neural classical density functional (cDFT) framework for carbon capture processes that allows direct calculation of adsorption isotherms from low to high loading limits of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) without grand canonical simulations. We demonstrate the success of our approach by calculating the ab initio adsorption isotherms for over 5,000 experimentally reported MOFs. From our screening, we show how these materials can be characterized using four isotherm shapes, arising from their pore size and binding sites, which the Henry constant cannot distinguish. We show that these shapes, rather than the binding strength alone, decide which MOFs suit which process: small pores with strong binding sites for vacuum and temperature swings at low pressure, large pores with weakly binding walls for pressure swings. Finally, we identify the most promising candidates by weighing their working capacity against the energy needed for regeneration.

AI.tldr: 该文提出神经经典密度泛函（neural cDFT）框架，可直接由从头算势能面计算MOF的CO2吸附等温线，避免昂贵的巨正则模拟；对5000余种实验报道MOF进行筛选，按四种等温线形状区分材料并匹配不同碳捕集工艺。
AI.motivation: 结合精确从头算相互作用处理的巨正则分子模拟计算等温线和吸附热极其昂贵，使筛选通常只能依赖低压Henry常数，无法充分区分材料；需要一种能基于从头算势能面（如基础机器学习原子间势MLIPs）高效计算吸附性质的方法。
AI.method: 开发用于碳捕集过程的神经经典密度泛函（neural cDFT）框架，无需巨正则模拟即可直接计算MOF从低负载到高负载的吸附等温线；利用从头算势能面计算5000余种实验报道MOF的吸附等温线，并依据孔径和结合位点将其归纳为四种等温线形状，同时比较工作容量与再生能耗。
AI.result: 成功计算了5000余种实验报道MOF的从头算吸附等温线；发现四种由孔径和结合位点产生的等温线形状，而Henry常数无法区分这些形状；这些形状而非仅结合强度决定工艺适配性：小孔且强结合位点适合低压真空/温度摆动，大孔且弱结合壁面适合压力摆动；并通过权衡工作容量与再生能耗识别出有前景的候选材料。摘要未提供具体数值性能指标。
AI.conclusion: 吸附等温线形状比单一结合强度更能决定MOF适用的碳捕集工艺；神经cDFT框架可高效地由从头算势能面预测低至高负载吸附等温线，从而支持大规模MOF筛选和候选材料设计。摘要未给出定量筛选阈值或实验验证细节。

title: Surrogate Modeling and Reduced-Order Methods in Gravitational-Wave Physics and Numerical Relativity: From Spectral Representations to Adaptive Compression
summary: The rapid expansion of gravitational-wave astronomy and high-precision numerical relativity has created an acute computational bottleneck: direct numerical integration of the Einstein field equations and high-dimensional Bayesian parameter estimation require millions of waveform evaluations that cannot be sustained by traditional solvers alone. Reduced-order modeling (ROM) and surrogate techniques have emerged as foundational tools to bridge this gap, compressing high-fidelity solution manifolds into compact, rapidly evaluable representations without sacrificing physical accuracy. This perspective reviews the mathematical pillars of projection-based reduced-order modeling---including Proper Orthogonal Decomposition, greedy basis selection, and the Empirical Interpolation Method---and traces their operational impact in gravitational-wave data analysis through surrogate waveform families and Reduced-Order Quadratures. We then examine the fundamental approximation barriers posed by slow Kolmogorov n-width decay in non-stationary, transient, and strongly nonlinear regimes, showing how adaptive hp-greedy domain partitioning and multi-scale spectral compression overcome these limits. Finally, we discuss how combining certified reduced-order structures with modern scientific machine learning and sensitivity-aware quantization provides a rigorous blueprint for next-generation detectors such as LISA, Einstein Telescope, and Cosmic Explorer.

AI.tldr: 该文是一篇视角/综述文章，围绕引力波天文学与高精度数值相对论中的计算瓶颈，梳理投影型降阶建模的数学基础及其在引力波数据分析中的应用，并讨论针对慢 Kolmogorov n-width 衰减的自适应与多尺度压缩方法，最后提出将认证降阶结构与科学机器学习、灵敏度感知量化结合，以服务下一代探测器。
AI.motivation: 引力波天文学快速发展及高精度数值相对论带来严重计算瓶颈：直接数值积分爱因斯坦场方程和高维贝叶斯参数估计需要数百万次波形评估，传统求解器难以持续支撑，因此需要降阶建模与代理模型在不牺牲物理精度的前提下压缩高保真解流形并实现快速评估。
AI.method: 文章以视角/综述方式回顾投影型降阶建模的数学支柱，包括本征正交分解（POD）、贪心基选择和经验插值法（EIM），并追踪其通过代理波形族和降阶求积在引力波数据分析中的实际作用；进一步分析非定常、瞬态和强非线性区域中 Kolmogorov n-width 衰减缓慢造成的近似障碍，说明自适应 hp-greedy 域划分和多尺度谱压缩如何克服这些限制；最后讨论将认证降阶结构与现代科学机器学习及灵敏度感知量化相结合。
AI.result: 摘要报告了该领域方法框架和应用影响的系统性梳理：投影型降阶建模可压缩高保真解流形并支持快速波形评估，代理波形族与降阶求积已体现操作影响；自适应 hp-greedy 域划分和多尺度谱压缩可应对慢 Kolmogorov n-width 衰减带来的近似限制。摘要未提供具体数值结果或性能提升幅度。
AI.conclusion: 论文认为，将认证降阶结构与现代科学机器学习、灵敏度感知量化结合，可为 LISA、爱因斯坦望远镜和宇宙探索者等下一代探测器提供严格的蓝图；其核心价值在于以可快速评估且保持物理精度的降阶表示缓解引力波建模与参数估计的计算瓶颈。

title: Early spectra of AT2017gfo from scaled 3D merger ejecta: mass--velocity distribution, 3D structure, and treatment of line opacity
comment: 22 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to MNRAS
summary: We present ARTIS radiative transfer calculations for neutron star merger ejecta with line-by-line opacities, wavelength-calibrated lanthanide data, and time-dependent r-process compositions and thermalisation, testing how the early kilonova depends on the mass-velocity distribution, dimensionality, and line treatment. We rescale 3D dynamical ejecta from a merger simulation in density and velocity to approximate AT2017gfo. Mass scaling alone provides good agreement with the bolometric light curve but inconsistent spectra. With velocities additionally halved, the model also reproduces the observed spectra at 1.4, 2.4, and (albeit less accurately) 3.4 days. The Sr II triplet contributes most to the 10500 $\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$ peak, and La III and Gd III to the 13500 $\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$ shoulder. Although hydrodynamically not fully self-consistent, this model is to our knowledge the first kilonova model based on calibrated atomic data that reproduces the light curve and main spectral features of the early AT2017gfo, suggesting that total (dynamical plus post-merger) ejecta with higher mass, lower velocity, and similar composition compared to our dynamical ejecta could explain AT2017gfo. A 2D azimuthal average mixes lanthanide-poor with lanthanide-rich regions, smooths the density, and makes the averaged model three times fainter at 1 day and redder throughout than the 3D model, highlighting the importance of 3D modelling. We compare the line-by-line macroatom treatment with expansion-opacity and line-binned schemes with thermal redistribution, using identical atomic data. Luminosities agree to $\lesssim 10$ per cent after 1 day, but the expansion-opacity scheme, unlike converged line-binned schemes, overestimates the spectral flux by up to 20 per cent, which can bias inferred abundances.

AI.tldr: 该文用ARTIS开展含逐线不透明度、波长校准镧系数据及随时间变化的r过程成分与热化处理的中子星并合抛射物辐射转移计算，检验早期千新星对质量-速度分布、维度和谱线处理方式的依赖。
AI.motivation: 旨在检验早期千新星（以AT2017gfo为参照）对抛射物质量-速度分布、3D/2D维度和谱线处理方案的依赖，并评估不同不透明度处理对光谱和丰度推断的影响。
AI.method: 对并合模拟得到的3D动力学抛射物在密度和速度上进行重标定以近似AT2017gfo；比较仅质量标定与进一步将速度减半的模型；用2D方位角平均检验维度影响；在相同原子数据下比较逐线宏观原子（macroatom）、膨胀不透明度及带热再分配的line-binned方案。
AI.result: 仅质量标定可较好符合热光变曲线但光谱不一致；速度再减半后模型还能在1.4、2.4天符合观测光谱，3.4天符合较差。Sr II三重线主要贡献10500 Å峰，La III和Gd III贡献13500 Å肩。2D方位角平均混合贫镧系与富镧系区域并平滑密度，使1天光度约为3D模型的三分之一且整体更红。逐线宏观原子与line-binned方案在1天后光度相差≲10%，但膨胀不透明度方案可将光谱流量高估至多20%，而收敛的line-binned方案不会。
AI.conclusion: 该模型虽在流体力学上并非完全自洽，但据作者所知是首个基于校准原子数据、能重现早期AT2017gfo光变曲线和主要光谱特征的千新星模型；结果表明总（动力学加后并合）抛射物若具有更高质量、更低速度和相似成分，可能解释AT2017gfo。3D建模很重要，膨胀不透明度处理可能使推断丰度产生偏差。

title: Gutzwiller Quantum-Classical Embedding for Dynamics Simulations of Correlated Electron Systems
summary: Simulating the real-time dynamics of correlated electron systems requires a nonperturbative treatment of local correlations over long times, a challenge for classical methods. We present the time-dependent Gutzwiller quantum-classical embedding framework, t-GQCE, for generic multi-orbital lattice models with time-dependent Hamiltonians. Within the time-dependent ghost Gutzwiller approximation, the lattice dynamics is mapped onto a noninteracting quasiparticle lattice, propagated classically, coupled to finite interacting embedding models propagated on quantum processors. The two parts exchange only embedding Hamiltonian parameters and single-particle density matrices, and the framework is agnostic to the quantum dynamics solver. We demonstrate it with adaptive variational quantum dynamics simulations of interaction quenches in the Hubbard model on the Bethe lattice. Without ghost orbitals, the embedding problem reduces to a single qubit, simulated on IBM quantum hardware with two qubits, including an ancilla. With more ghost orbitals, t-GQCE suppresses the artificial undamped oscillations of the conventional Gutzwiller approximation and approaches nonequilibrium dynamical mean-field theory results for weak and strong quenches. Statevector simulations with 2, 4 and 6 ghost orbitals per spin, or 8, 12 and 16 qubits, give adaptive circuits that follow the embedding states with infidelities below $5\times10^{-4}$. Under trapped-ion noise models, circuit compression, measurements in rotated orbital bases with post-selection, and noise mitigation reduce the measurement errors severalfold. At one third of the error rates of a hardware-benchmarked noise model, they reach an accuracy of $0.01$ for the single-particle density matrix and the double occupancy with $10^5$ shots per time step, and the Quantinuum H2-Emulator gives similar accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 t-GQCE：一种将含时 Ghost Gutzwiller 近似与量子处理器上的有限相互作用嵌入模型相结合的时间依赖量子-经典嵌入框架，用于多轨道晶格模型的实时非微扰动力学，并在 Hubbard 模型淬火中验证了其可行性与精度。
AI.motivation: 模拟关联电子系统的实时动力学需要对局部关联进行长时间的非微扰处理，这对经典方法构成挑战；因此需要一种可扩展的量子-经典混合方案。
AI.method: 在时间依赖 ghost Gutzwiller 近似下，将晶格动力学映射为非相互作用准粒子晶格，用经典方法传播，并与在量子处理器上传播的有限相互作用嵌入模型耦合。两部分仅交换嵌入哈密顿量参数和单粒子密度矩阵，且不依赖特定量子动力学求解器。作者用自适应变分量子动力学模拟 Bethe 晶格 Hubbard 模型的相互作用淬火进行演示。
AI.result: 无 ghost 轨道时嵌入问题退化为单量子比特，并在 IBM 硬件上用含辅助比特的两个量子比特模拟。增加 ghost 轨道后，t-GQCE 抑制传统 Gutzwiller 近似的人为无阻尼振荡，并在弱淬火和强淬火下接近非平衡动力学平均场理论结果。每自旋 2、4、6 个 ghost 轨道（即 8、12、16 量子比特）的态矢量模拟给出自适应电路，嵌入态不保真度低于 5×10^-4。在俘获离子噪声模型下，电路压缩、旋转轨道基测量与后选择及噪声缓解将测量误差降低数倍；在硬件基准噪声模型三分之一误差率下，以每时间步 10^5 次测量达到单粒子密度矩阵和双占据数 0.01 的精度，Quantinuum H2-Emulator 给出类似精度。
AI.conclusion: t-GQCE 为含时多轨道关联电子系统的非微扰实时动力学提供了可行的量子-经典嵌入路径；ghost 轨道对抑制传统 Gutzwiller 的人工振荡和提升与 DMFT 的一致性至关重要，且框架对量子动力学求解器保持通用。

title: Machine-learned potentials for iron oxides at extreme conditions
summary: Reliable phase stability requires accurate relative free energies, which small force errors alone do not guarantee. We develop atomic-cluster-expansion potentials for five iron oxides from Fe$_2$O to Fe$_2$O$_3$, covering crystalline and liquid states at 140--260\,GPa and 1000--11000\,K, with electronic and ionic temperatures matched. Force-dominated training leaves systematic energy offsets between structure families of up to 41\,meV/atom that persist despite additional training data. Stronger energy weighting and weaker regularization largely remove these offsets, while converged k-point sampling prevents further composition-dependent biases. The final potentials achieve held-out energy errors of 2.0--5.5\,meV/atom and first-order free-energy errors within 3.4\,meV/atom for liquids at 5000--9000\,K. However, an untrained NiAs-type FeO phase exhibits a free-energy error of 57\,meV/atom despite a low extrapolation grade. These results show that reliable phase-diagram calculations require control of relative energy offsets and explicit free-energy validation of every competing phase.

AI.tldr: 该工作为五种铁氧化物构建原子团簇展开势，发现仅靠力误差训练会留下最高41 meV/atom的体系性能量偏移，需通过能量加权、弱正则化和收敛k点控制；最终势的留出能量误差为2.0–5.5 meV/atom，液态一阶自由能误差在3.4 meV/atom以内，但未训练的NiAs型FeO仍出现57 meV/atom的自由能误差。
AI.motivation: 可靠的相稳定性需要准确的相对自由能，而仅依靠小的力误差并不能保证这一点，因此需要系统控制训练中的相对能量偏移并对竞争相进行自由能验证。
AI.method: 开发覆盖Fe2O至Fe2O3五种铁氧化物的原子团簇展开势，适用于140–260 GPa、1000–11000 K的晶态和液态，并匹配电子温度和离子温度；分析力主导训练造成的能量偏移，采用更强的能量加权和更弱的正则化，并使用收敛的k点采样。
AI.result: 力主导训练在结构族之间产生最高41 meV/atom的系统性能量偏移，增加训练数据后仍存在；更强能量加权和更弱正则化基本消除这些偏移，收敛k点采样防止进一步成分依赖偏差。最终势的留出能量误差为2.0–5.5 meV/atom，5000–9000 K液态的一阶自由能误差在3.4 meV/atom以内；但未训练的NiAs型FeO相尽管外推等级较低，自由能误差仍达57 meV/atom。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的相图计算需要控制相对能量偏移，并对每一个竞争相进行显式自由能验证，不能仅凭力误差或外推等级判断势的可靠性。

title: Numerical integration of non-local master equations for renewal shot noise with drift and state-dependent amplitude
summary: The probability density of a system driven by a drift and a renewal train of kicks with state-dependent amplitude obeys a master equation that is non-local in space, because the kick operator $\hat{p}(i\partial_x I(x))$ is of infinite order, and, for non-exponential waiting times, non-local in time, with a memory kernel containing the propagator of the drift. Its solutions contain quasi-singular components, the never-kicked mass, which collapse onto the attractors of the drift. We present an accurate numerical method for such equations. The kick operator is a push-forward along the Marcus flow; in the Lamperti variable it becomes a translation, whose exact cell-to-cell weights follow from the cumulative distribution of the kicks, without quadrature. The drift is integrated by a conservative semi-Lagrangian step exact in time. The memory is represented by a sum of exponentials whose auxiliary fields are advected by the drift, at a cost linear in the number of steps. The never-kicked mass is transported exactly. For each ingredient we quantify the errors of simpler alternatives. The method is verified against exact solutions and event-driven Monte Carlo simulations with exact flow maps, from which it is statistically indistinguishable with $10^8$ trajectories. Parameters tuned for Gaussian kicks carry over unchanged to other kick distributions, and near a zero of the coupling, where the density vanishes faster than any power, the solution follows the known asymptotic law down to densities of order $10^{-37}$, far beyond Monte Carlo reach. As an application we compare the exact equation with its local and Poissonian approximations: in the range explored, the local equation deviates by up to 8% of the density width, also for waiting times with finite mean, consistently with an error estimate predicting larger deviations for slow drifts at long times. A Fortran implementation is available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种精确高效的数值方法，用于求解由漂移和状态依赖的更新脉冲列驱动的非局域主方程，并用精确解与大规模蒙特卡洛验证，进而比较局域与泊松近似。
AI.motivation: 该系统的概率密度满足的方程在空间上非局域，因为脉冲算符为无限阶；对非指数等待时间还在时间上非局域，并含漂移传播子的记忆核。其解包含准奇异的“从未被踢质量”，会坍缩到漂移吸引子上，因此需要能准确处理这些结构的数值方法。
AI.method: 将脉冲算符视为沿Marcus流的推前；在Lamperti变量下化为平移，其精确的格到格权重由脉冲累积分布直接得到而无需求积。漂移采用时间精确的保守半拉格朗日步。记忆核表示为指数和，其辅助场随漂移平流，计算代价随步数线性增长；“从未被踢质量”被精确输运。作者还量化了更简单替代方案在各环节的误差，并用精确解及带精确流映射的事件驱动蒙特卡洛进行验证。
AI.result: 该方法与10^8条轨迹的事件驱动蒙特卡洛在统计上不可区分；为高斯脉冲调好的参数可不变地用于其他脉冲分布；在耦合零点附近，密度以快于任何幂次的速度消失，解在低至约10^-37的密度仍遵循已知渐近律，远超蒙特卡洛可达范围。应用中将精确方程与局域及泊松近似比较：在所探索范围内，局域方程偏差最高达密度宽度的8%，对有限平均等待时间亦然，这与预测慢漂移、长时间下偏差更大的误差估计一致。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能准确、高效地求解含非局域脉冲、非指数等待时间和准奇异未踢质量的漂移-更新脉冲主方程，并可用于严格评估局域和泊松近似的误差；Fortran实现已提供。摘要未给出具体收敛阶、完整参数设置及误差量化的全部数值细节。

title: Stochastic Optimisation for Scalable Ptychographic Image Reconstruction
summary: X-ray ptychography is a lensless coherent diffraction imaging technique capable of high spatial resolution, in which an image is reconstructed by solving a large-scale inverse problem from highly redundant far-field diffraction measurements acquired under overlapping illumination. Whilst the measurement redundancy created by overlapping illumination is essential for reconstruction fidelity, it leads to computational and memory demands that scale poorly with object size and target resolution when using conventional reconstruction algorithms. This work proposes a ptychographic reconstruction framework that reduces peak memory usage and time to convergence by leveraging stochastic optimisation techniques developed for large-scale machine learning. Specifically, the framework employs stochastic gradient descent with a decaying step size that progressively reduces the effect of gradient noise, referred to here as variance reduction (VR), with gradients that agree with automatic differentiation, to optimise the ptychographic forward model using randomly sampled subsets of diffraction measurements. For an experimental dataset of 200,000 diffraction patterns of $128\times128$ pixels, VR is demonstrated to require $65\%$ of the peak GPU memory and $22\%$ of the reconstruction time of the established maximum-likelihood (ML) algorithm. The VR framework incorporates the Poisson maximum-likelihood formulation and partial coherence within a unified and extensible optimisation setting. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the framework achieves reconstruction quality visually comparable to established methods, with lower peak GPU memory and a shorter time

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于随机优化的X射线叠层衍射成像重建框架，利用带衰减步长的随机梯度下降（方差缩减）从随机采样的衍射数据子集中优化前向模型，以降低峰值GPU内存和收敛时间。
AI.motivation: 传统叠层衍射重建中，重叠照明带来的测量冗余虽对重建保真度必要，但会使计算和内存需求随物体尺寸和目标分辨率严重增长，因此需要降低峰值内存使用和收敛时间。
AI.method: 采用面向大规模机器学习的随机优化技术：使用带衰减步长的随机梯度下降，逐步降低梯度噪声影响（称为方差缩减，VR），其梯度与自动微分一致；通过随机采样衍射测量子集优化叠层衍射前向模型。该框架还将泊松最大似然表述和部分相干性纳入统一、可扩展的优化设置。
AI.result: 在包含200000幅128×128像素衍射图的实验数据集上，VR所需峰值GPU内存为既定最大似然算法的65%，重建时间为22%。数值实验表明，该框架达到与既定方法视觉上可比的重建质量，同时峰值GPU内存更低、时间更短。
AI.conclusion: VR框架可在保持视觉上可比重建质量的同时降低峰值GPU内存和重建时间，并提供统一、可扩展的优化设置以纳入泊松最大似然和部分相干性。

title: FDM+: A Framework for Constrained Control of the 2D Radiative Transport Equation
summary: Applying the frozen diffusion model (FDM) [29] to the constrained control of the 2D radiative transport equation presents several challenges. These include the dimensional difference between control variables and state functions, the resolution mismatch between traditional numerical solvers and deep learning models, and solution non-uniqueness. To address these obstacles, we propose a novel approach, FDM+, which includes three key improvements. Firstly, a decoupled prediction architecture is introduced to address the dimensional heterogeneity. Secondly, an efficient parameterization strategy resolves the resolution mismatch. Meanwhile, we derive a total error bound to analyze how the parameterization error and the model estimation error jointly affect the performance. Thirdly, the conditional distribution learned by the diffusion model is leveraged to perform design space exploration for multi-solution problems. A series of numerical experiments demonstrate that FDM+ outperforms existing methods in reconstruction accuracy and design flexibility.

AI.tldr: 论文针对将冻结扩散模型（FDM）用于二维辐射传输方程约束控制时的维度不匹配、分辨率不匹配与解不唯一问题，提出包含三项改进的FDM+，并通过数值实验验证其在重建精度和设计灵活性上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 将FDM应用于二维辐射传输方程的约束控制面临三类挑战：控制变量与状态函数之间存在维度差异；传统数值求解器与深度学习模型之间存在分辨率不匹配；问题存在解不唯一性。
AI.method: 提出FDM+，包含三项关键改进：一是引入解耦预测架构以处理维度异质性；二是采用高效参数化策略解决分辨率不匹配，并推导总误差界以分析参数化误差与模型估计误差对性能的联合影响；三是利用扩散模型学习到的条件分布对多解问题进行设计空间探索。
AI.result: 一系列数值实验表明，FDM+在重建精度和设计灵活性方面优于现有方法；摘要未提供具体定量指标、对比基线或实验设置细节。
AI.conclusion: FDM+能够应对FDM用于二维辐射传输方程约束控制中的维度差异、分辨率不匹配和解不唯一等障碍，并在重建精度与设计灵活性上取得优于现有方法的表现；摘要未给出更具体的理论保证或应用范围结论。

title: General Noise Channels and Mid-Circuit Measurements for Pre-Trajectory Sampling with Batched Execution
comment: 25 pages, 8 figures (4 in the main text, 4 in the Supplementary Information)
summary: Many studies of quantum protocols require fast sampling of large amounts of measurement data from noisy quantum circuits, such as for training machine-learning decoders for quantum error correction. Exact simulation of realistic noise is expensive, while stabilizer-based simulators are fast but approximate, for example through Pauli twirling, which generally alters the output statistics. Pre-trajectory sampling with batched execution (PTSBE) accelerates exact trajectory simulation by sampling noise before state evolution. This method requires the outcome probability of every stochastic event to be independent of the state, which excludes mid-circuit measurements and general Kraus channels. We present a generalization of PTSBE to measurement and Kraus operators without approximation. Each event is partially pre-sampled, while deferred outcomes are drawn during grouped execution via multinomial branching and cached-state reuse. We implement the method for GPUs as an extension of CUDA-Q. On distance-3 topological code memories under amplitude damping, it is up to 24x faster than conventional trajectory sampling in CUDA-Q. On 30-qubit random circuits with mid-circuit measurements, it is up to 83x faster and outperforms the near-Clifford simulator Clifft when more than about 25% of the gates are non-Clifford. With repeated sampling of each final state, its sampling rate per trajectory exceeds that of CUDA-Q by nearly five orders of magnitude. Our method also allows us to compare exact amplitude damping with its Pauli-twirled channel on a surface-code memory, revealing that twirling overestimates the detection rate by 21% and raises the logical error rate of a lookup decoder by 8%. This work makes exact, high-throughput simulation practical for general noisy circuits, from data generation for training decoders to studying measurement-based fault-tolerant protocols under realistic noise.

AI.tldr: 提出PTSBE的无近似推广，将预轨迹采样扩展到含中电路测量与通用Kraus算符的噪声电路，并在GPU版CUDA-Q中实现；在多种基准上显著加速，且揭示Pauli twirling会扭曲表面码存储器的错误统计。
AI.motivation: 量子协议研究（如训练量子纠错的机器学习解码器）需要从噪声量子电路快速采样大量测量数据。精确模拟现实噪声开销高，而基于稳定子的模拟虽快却常通过Pauli twirling等近似改变输出统计。原有PTSBE虽能加速精确轨迹模拟，但要求每个随机事件的結果概率与量子态无关，因而无法处理中电路测量和通用Kraus信道。
AI.method: 提出PTSBE的推广：对每个事件进行部分预采样，将延迟的结果在分组执行阶段通过多项分支抽取，并复用缓存状态，从而在不引入近似的情况下支持测量与Kraus算符。将该方法作为CUDA-Q的扩展在GPU上实现。
AI.result: 在振幅阻尼下的距离3拓扑码存储器上，比CUDA-Q传统轨迹采样最高快24倍；在含中电路测量的30量子比特随机电路上最高快83倍，且当非Clifford门占比超过约25%时优于近Clifford模拟器Clifft；对每个最终态重复采样时，每轨迹采样率比CUDA-Q高近五个数量级。还比较了精确振幅阻尼与其Pauli twirled信道在表面码存储器上的表现，发现twirling将检测率高估21%，并使查找解码器的逻辑错误率提高8%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使通用噪声电路的精确实时高吞吐模拟变得实用，可服务于解码器训练数据生成以及在实际噪声下研究基于测量的容错协议。

title: Technical Note on Matlantis PFP v9: Extending the Element and Domain Coverage of the r2SCAN Training Data
summary: Universal machine learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) make atomistic simulations possible at scales beyond the reach of density functional theory (DFT). Matlantis PFP is a uMLIP that treats a variety of domains, including crystals, molecules, and surfaces, with a single model. PFP v8 incorporated a training dataset computed with the r2SCAN functional, chosen for its good agreement with experiment, but the elements and domains covered by that dataset were limited. Here we present Matlantis PFP v9, in which the training data computed with the r2SCAN functional are extended to the lanthanides from Pr to Lu and to the elements from Po to Cm, for a total of 96 elements, and to additional domains such as clusters and adsorption structures. The formation energies of crystals containing the newly supported elements reproduce experimental standard enthalpies of formation with the same level of accuracy as crystals composed only of previously supported elements, and the adsorption energies of molecules on transition-metal surfaces have an overall error against experiment comparable to that of DFT-PBE, although chemisorbed species are overbound. On the same type of GPU (A100), the inference speed and the maximum system size exceed those of SevenNet-Omni, a public uMLIP trained on r2SCAN data: forces are evaluated three to four times faster, and five to ten times as many atoms can be handled. As a result, PFP-R2SCAN is now applicable to systems containing rare-earth and actinide elements and to adsorption on surfaces.

AI.tldr: Matlantis PFP v9 将基于 r2SCAN 的训练数据扩展至 96 种元素及团簇、吸附等新体系，在保持晶体形成能精度的同时提升推理速度与体系规模。
AI.motivation: uMLIP 可在超出 DFT 的尺度开展原子模拟，但 PFP v8 的 r2SCAN 训练数据在元素和体系类型上覆盖有限。
AI.method: 扩展 r2SCAN 训练数据至 Pr 到 Lu 的镧系元素及 Po 到 Cm 的元素，共 96 种元素，并加入团簇和吸附结构等体系，训练单一 Matlantis PFP v9 模型；用实验数据评估晶体形成能和表面吸附能，并在 A100 GPU 上与 SevenNet-Omni 比较推理速度和最大体系规模。
AI.result: 含新支持元素的晶体形成能对实验标准生成焓的精度与仅含原支持元素的晶体相当；分子在过渡金属表面的吸附能总体误差与 DFT-PBE 相当，但化学吸附物种被过度结合。相同 A100 GPU 上，力评估比 SevenNet-Omni 快 3 至 4 倍，可处理原子数为 5 至 10 倍。
AI.conclusion: PFP-R2SCAN 现已可应用于含稀土和锕系元素的体系以及表面吸附问题。

title: Kernel Design in Particle Mesh Ewald Methods: Splitting, Interpolation, and Upsampling
summary: For more than thirty years, particle mesh Ewald (PME) methods have dominated the computation of electrostatic interactions in molecular dynamics. A PME method uses a splitting kernel to divide the interaction into a local part, summed within a cutoff, and a smooth part, computed on a grid with a spreading and interpolation (SI) kernel. The established methods use Ewald's Gaussian split with B-spline SI kernels, and the recent Ewald summation with prolates accelerates them severalfold by using a prolate spheroidal wave function (PSWF) for both kernels. Neither choice meets two needs of molecular dynamics: a smooth energy, which long simulations need in order to conserve it, and a low-order SI kernel that stays accurate on coarse grids and gains accuracy as the grid is refined. We present a framework for designing both kernels to meet these needs. For inverse powers from the Coulomb to the dispersion interaction, our splits make the local part smooth at the cutoff to any order while keeping the Fourier concentration of the smooth part close to optimal. We show that with analytic differentiation, the force error of a continuous SI kernel of fixed shape vanishes under grid refinement only if every particle, wherever it lies, gives the grid its exact charge and dipole moment. Our SI kernel for the Coulomb interaction ensures this by construction and is twice continuously differentiable. Compared with the B-spline of the same order, it needs fewer grid points by a factor of up to nearly five; on coarse grids, it mostly needs a lower order than the PSWF kernel. In simulations of liquid water over 100 million time steps, the new kernels reduce the energy drift of both the established and the PSWF kernels by about three orders of magnitude, with a smaller force error than either. Existing PME codes can adopt them by replacing only the two kernels and the Fourier multiplier.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一套用于设计 PME 静电计算中分裂核与扩散-插值（SI）核的框架，使局部部分在截断处任意阶光滑、光滑部分傅里叶集中度接近最优，并给出满足网格细化下力误差消失条件的 Coulomb SI 核；新核在粗网格上更省网格点，并在长时间水分子模拟中显著降低能量漂移。
AI.motivation: PME 方法三十多年来主导分子动力学静电计算，但现有 Gaussian 分裂加 B 样条 SI 核，以及用 PSWF 同时构造两个核的 Ewald prolates 方法，均未同时满足分子动力学对光滑能量（长时间模拟需守恒能量）和低阶 SI 核（粗网格准确且随网格细化提升精度）的需求。
AI.method: 提出同时设计分裂核和 SI 核的框架，覆盖 Coulomb 到色散相互作用的逆幂势：使局部部分在截断处达到任意阶光滑，同时保持光滑部分的傅里叶集中度接近最优。通过解析微分分析指出，固定形状连续 SI 核的力误差在网格细化下消失，当且仅当每个粒子无论位于何处都向网格贡献精确的电荷和偶极矩；据此构造的 Coulomb SI 核满足该条件且二次连续可微。现有 PME 代码只需替换两个核和傅里叶乘子即可采用。
AI.result: 与同阶 B 样条相比，新 SI 核所需网格点最多可少近五倍；在粗网格上，其阶数大多低于 PSWF 核。在液态水 1 亿时间步模拟中，新核使既有方法和 PSWF 方法的能量漂移均降低约三个数量级，且力误差小于二者。
AI.conclusion: 新框架设计的核同时满足光滑能量和低阶、粗网格准确 SI 核的需求，并在长时间分子动力学模拟中显著优于既有 B 样条和 PSWF 方案；其可通过仅替换两个核及傅里叶乘子集成到现有 PME 代码中。

title: MAIC-2 v2.3: A Fortran program for simulating the surface temperature, atmospheric water transport and surface glaciation of the planet Mars
summary: The Mars Atmosphere-Ice Coupler MAIC-2 is a computationally efficient, zonally-averaged model designed to simulate Martian surface temperature, atmospheric water transport and surface glaciation over timescales of 10^5 to 10^7 years. While sophisticated General Circulation Models (GCMs) provide high-resolution simulations of the Martian atmosphere, their high computational cost makes them largely unsuitable for studies covering millions of years of orbital evolution. MAIC-2 addresses this gap by utilizing physically-based, zonally-averaged parameterizations, including a Local Insolation Temperature (LIT) scheme and a mass balance engine driven by free-convection and instantaneous mixing physics. Version 2.3 introduces a fully modularized Fortran architecture that improves maintainability and ensures that the software remains entirely self-contained, requiring no external numerical libraries or specialized data formats for execution. Demonstrated through a 20-million-year transient simulation, the model successfully reproduces the primary characteristics of the Martian polar layered deposits. MAIC-2 provides the planetary science community with a versatile, open-source tool for investigating the long-term climatic impacts of orbital variations on the Martian surface.

AI.tldr: MAIC-2 是一个计算高效、纬向平均的火星大气-冰耦合模型，用于模拟 10^5–10^7 年尺度上的火星表面温度、大气水输运和表面冰川化；2.3 版采用模块化 Fortran 架构，并通过 2000 万年瞬态模拟再现火星极地层状沉积物的主要特征。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率通用环流模式（GCM）计算成本高，难以用于覆盖数百万年轨道演化的研究，因此需要一个计算高效且能描述长期气候演化的火星气候模型。
AI.method: MAIC-2 采用物理基础的纬向平均参数化方案，包括局地日照温度（LIT）方案，以及由自由对流和瞬时混合物理驱动的质量平衡引擎；2.3 版采用完全模块化的 Fortran 架构，软件自包含，不依赖外部数值库或特殊数据格式。
AI.result: 通过一个 2000 万年瞬态模拟，模型成功再现了火星极地层状沉积物的主要特征；摘要未提供定量误差、与观测或其他模型的系统对比指标。
AI.conclusion: MAIC-2 为行星科学界提供了一个通用、开源的工具，可用于研究轨道变化对火星表面长期气候的影响。

title: Reliability by Architecture: Agentic Workflows for Validated Multi-Physics Simulation from Natural Language
summary: Preparing, executing, and validating strongly coupled multi-physics simulations require expert time. Agentic workflows use large language models (LLMs) to coordinate them from natural-language descriptions, but reliability requires checks of physical consistency and fidelity to the problem description. Our agentic harness implements explicit task allocation: LLMs interpret user requests and simulator diagnostics, generate input components not covered by predefined construction rules, and propose repairs, while deterministic routines construct supported components and check inputs, edits, and results. We evaluate CO2-storage problems using the multi-physics simulator GEOS, from compositional flow to flow-poromechanics with frictional fault contact. In 80 attempts on two flow problems, grounding raises the proportion of structurally valid inputs from 5/20 to 20/20, but acceptance reaches 20/20 only with complete rule-based input preparation. With identical inputs, local repairs correct three seeded defects while preserving valid inputs. Supporting tests identify simulations passing physics checks despite differing from the problem description or reference results.

AI.tldr: 论文研究用LLM智能体工作流自动准备、执行和验证强耦合多物理场仿真，并以CO2封存中的GEOS仿真评估其可靠性与物理一致性检查。
AI.motivation: 强耦合多物理场仿真的准备、执行和验证需要专家投入大量时间；LLM智能体工作流可根据自然语言描述协调这些流程，但必须检查物理一致性以及对问题描述的忠实度，因此需要提高可靠性。
AI.method: 提出一种具有显式任务分配的智能体框架：LLM负责解释用户请求和模拟器诊断、生成预定义构造规则未覆盖的输入组件并提出修复建议；确定性程序负责构造受支持的组件，并检查输入、编辑和结果。评估使用多物理场模拟器GEOS求解CO2封存问题，涵盖从组分流动到含摩擦断层接触的流动-孔隙力学问题，并在两个流动问题上进行80次尝试。
AI.result: 在80次尝试中，grounding将结构有效输入的比例从5/20提高到20/20，但只有采用完整的基于规则的输入准备时接受率才达到20/20；在相同输入下，局部修复纠正了三个植入缺陷，同时保留有效输入；支持性测试识别出虽通过物理检查、却与问题描述或参考结果不同的仿真。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将LLM的语义解释与生成能力和确定性构造与检查相结合，可提升智能体多物理场仿真工作流的输入有效性；但结构有效或通过物理检查并不必然保证与问题描述及参考结果一致，仍需多层次验证。摘要未提供超出上述实验范围的结论。

title: Quantum-classical dynamical density functional theory for solvation dynamics
summary: We provide a unified modeling framework for thermalization and non-equilibrium spectroscopy in overdamped polar environments. This framework extends dynamical density functional theory to describe the coupled quantum-classical evolution of a molecular electronic subsystem and an overdamped polar solvent represented by a reaction-field coordinate. The nonadiabatic dynamics is formulated in terms of an operator-valued distribution obeying a quantum-classical Ehrenfest--Smoluchowski equation which exhibits nonlinear classical diffusion and non-increasing free energy, thereby retaining detailed balance. In contrast, a quantum-classical Liouville--Smoluchowski model with quantum-classical linear diffusion develops unstable long-time behavior and fails to reach a stationary thermal state. The method is applied to a two-level model of a polar dye in three different solvents: chloroform, dichloromethane, and dimethyl sulfoxide, each differing in polarity and dielectric relaxation time. Absorption and time-resolved emission spectra are obtained from dipole-dipole correlation functions, capturing the solvent-induced spectral broadening, the dynamic Stokes shift, and the time evolution of the emission bandwidth. The calculated solvent spectral response agrees well with the experimental relaxation trends of the three solvents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个统一的过阻尼极性环境热化与非平衡光谱建模框架，将动力学密度泛函理论扩展到分子电子量子子系统与经典极性溶剂的耦合描述，并在三种溶剂中计算吸收与时间分辨发射光谱。
AI.motivation: 需要一个统一框架同时描述过阻尼极性环境中的热化和非平衡光谱，并能正确刻画量子电子子系统与经典极性溶剂的耦合；摘要还通过对比指出，采用量子-经典线性扩散的Liouville--Smoluchowski模型长期行为不稳定且无法达到热平衡稳态。
AI.method: 以反应场坐标表示过阻尼极性溶剂，将非绝热动力学表述为服从量子-经典Ehrenfest--Smoluchowski方程的操作符值分布；该方程包含非线性经典扩散、自由能非增并保持详细平衡。方法应用于氯仿、二氯甲烷和二甲基亚砜中极性染料的二能级模型，三种溶剂具有不同极性和介电弛豫时间；吸收和时间分辨发射光谱由偶极-偶极相关函数获得。
AI.result: 计算捕捉到溶剂诱导的光谱展宽、动态Stokes位移和发射带宽随时间的演化；三种溶剂的計算溶剂光谱响应与实验弛豫趋势吻合良好。作为对比，量子-经典线性扩散的Liouville--Smoluchowski模型表现出不稳定的长时间行为，未能达到稳态热态。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为过阻尼极性环境中的热化与非平衡光谱提供了统一的量子-经典描述；非线性经典扩散对保持详细平衡和获得稳定热化行为具有关键作用，且三种溶剂中的光谱弛豫趋势支持该方法的有效性。摘要未提供定量误差或更多体系验证。

title: Kinetic study of Reaction-Control-Jet Interference in Rarefied Hypersonic Crossflow
comment: 30 pages, 15 figures, 13 tables. To be submitted to Theoretical and Computational Fluid Dynamics
summary: A 1975 wind-tunnel study at the German Aerospace Center (DLR) of a helium jet blowing from a flat plate into a Mach 11 to 12 air crossflow at three freestream densities is revisited using two- and three-dimensional Direct Simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) computations at Knudsen numbers 0.021 to 0.125. The planar slot used in two-dimensional model computations reproduces the shock topology, the sign and two-lobed structure of the interference pressure and its trend with rarefaction, and its plate-alone boundary layer is consistent with the three-dimensional one and with a similarity solution with slip and temperature jump. However, two-dimensional simulations overpredict the peak interference pressure about twelvefold at every condition and carry it farther upstream. A resolution sweep at the most rarefied condition converges the planar interference to within 1% of its extrapolated limit. Three-dimensional DSMC reproduces the measured interference pressure at all three densities, within 25% at the lobe peak and 3 mm in its position, although two- and three-dimensional simulations overpredict the plate-alone wall pressure by 50 to 75%. Continuum breakdown around the jet persists even at the lowest Knudsen number examined. Fully three-dimensional kinetic simulations are underway to extend the present validation to a comparison of jet strength and forces over wider Knudsen number ranges, and to an examination of lateral relief as a reason for the discrepancy.

AI.tldr: 该文用二维和三维DSMC重新分析1975年DLR的氦射流/高超声速横流风洞实验，发现二维模拟能再现干扰压力拓扑但峰值高估约12倍，三维DSMC则能在实验密度条件下较好地复现干扰压力。
AI.motivation: 基于摘要，作者旨在重新审视1975年DLR风洞实验，在Kn数0.021至0.125范围内用二维和三维DSMC评估稀薄气体条件下射流干扰压力的模拟能力，并检验二维模型与三维实验之间的差异来源。
AI.method: 采用二维和三维直接模拟蒙特卡洛（DSMC）方法，计算平板氦射流喷入马赫11至12空气横流的流场；二维模型使用平面槽，开展网格分辨率扫描，并将平板边界层与三维结果及含滑移和温度跳跃的相似解比较；三维DSMC结果与三个来流密度下的实验干扰压力进行对比。
AI.result: 二维模拟再现了激波拓扑、干扰压力的符号和双瓣结构及其随稀薄化的趋势，平板边界层与三维结果及含滑移/温度跳跃的相似解一致；但二维峰值干扰压力在所有条件下高估约12倍，且位置更靠上游。最稀薄条件下的分辨率扫描使平面干扰压力收敛至外推极限的1%以内。三维DSMC在三个密度下均复现实验干扰压力，瓣峰处误差在25%以内、位置误差在3 mm以内；但二维和三维模拟均将平板单独壁面压力高估50%至75%。即便在最低Kn数下，射流周围仍存在连续介质失效。
AI.conclusion: 摘要表明三维DSMC对干扰压力的验证较好，而平板单独壁面压力仍被显著高估；二维模拟在定量预测干扰压力峰值方面不足。作者指出仍需开展完全三维动理学模拟，以在更宽Kn数范围内比较射流强度和受力，并考察侧向泄流是否解释差异。

title: Consistent interfacial flow numerics - Part II: The momentum convection term
summary: The two-phase Volume-of-Fluid solvers of OpenFOAM overpredict the horizontal water velocity near the crest of a water wave, and the error grows as the wave propagates. Part I of this series removed the spurious air velocities caused by the gravity term but left this error unchanged. Here we show that it is caused by the momentum convection term. Its mass flux is computed in the interface advection step from the velocity at the start of the time step, whereas the convected velocity is taken at the end of the step, because convection is discretised implicitly. In a progressive wave, where the horizontal and vertical velocities are 90 degrees out of phase, this time lag produces an upward flux of horizontal momentum, proportional to the time step, which accumulates in a spurious current near the surface. The same mismatch makes the response to a force depend on the density at the wrong time level. Explicit convection removes the lag and makes the response consistent with the gravity force, but requires the convected face velocity at the interface to be taken from the upwind cell. Only then is the new velocity of a cell a weighted average of old velocities, whatever the density ratio. We demonstrate both requirements with prescribed flows and with the full solver. For a progressive wave, explicit convection with upwind face velocities at the interface reduces the overprediction of the crest velocity from 26-31 % to within 1 % and removes the near-surface current. The resulting solver, fluxinator, is meant for maximum Courant numbers of 0.1 and below, where it keeps the wave height within 1.5 % over 15 periods on meshes with six or more cells per wave height. Because the spurious velocities that limit the time step are removed, it needs 34-42 % less wall-clock time than interFoam for the tested wave.

AI.tldr: 该文指出 OpenFOAM 两相 VOF 求解器在波峰附近高估水平水速且误差随波传播增长，根源是动量对流项中界面通量所用速度与隐式对流所用速度存在时间层不匹配；采用显式对流并在界面取上风格心面速度可消除滞后，所得 fluxinator 求解器将波峰速度高估从 26–31% 降至 1% 以内，并显著减少计算时间。
AI.motivation: OpenFOAM 的两相 Volume-of-Fluid 求解器在波峰附近会高估水平水速，且误差随波浪传播而增大。该系列 Part I 已去除重力项引起的虚假空气速度，但该误差未改变，因此本文旨在找出并消除这一剩余误差的来源。
AI.method: 作者分析认为误差来自动量对流项：界面平流步中的质量通量使用时间步开始时的速度，而对流速度因隐式离散取时间步结束时的速度；在水平与垂直速度相差 90° 的行进波中，这一时间滞后产生与时间步长成正比的向上水平动量通量，并在近水面累积为虚假流动；同样的不匹配使对力的响应取决于错误时间层的密度。作者采用显式对流消除滞后，使响应与重力项一致，但要求界面处对流面速度取自上游单元；只有如此，单元新速度才在任何密度比下均为旧速度的加权平均。作者用指定流场和完整求解器验证这两项要求，并构建 fluxinator 求解器，面向最大 Courant 数 0.1 及以下。
AI.result: 对于行进波，采用显式对流并在界面使用上风格心面速度，可将波峰速度高估从 26–31% 降至 1% 以内，并消除近水面虚假流动；在每波高六层及以上网格上，15 个周期内波高误差保持在 1.5% 以内；由于限制了时间步长的虚假速度被去除，测试波浪下所需墙钟时间比 interFoam 少 34–42%。
AI.conclusion: 本文确认动量对流项中的时间层不匹配是波峰水平速度高估和近水面虚假流动的来源，并证明显式对流结合界面处上风格心面速度可消除该问题。所得 fluxinator 适用于最大 Courant 数不超过 0.1 的场景，在保持波高精度的同时减少虚假速度并降低计算时间。

title: A boundary integral formulation for microscale Marangoni surfing
summary: We consider a model for collections of surfactant-producing particles moving along the surface of a viscous fluid under their self-generated Marangoni flows. Such systems are challenging due to their nonlocal nature: particle motion is coupled to Marangoni stresses distributed across the entire fluid surface and to the resulting flows in the bulk. In the low Reynolds and Péclet number limit, we reduce these nonlocal effects to a system of integral equations supported solely on the particles and their boundaries. This formulation is not only computationally tractable, but also provides a framework for systematically coarse-graining many-particle systems. Numerical simulations, performed with a custom spectral method, show collective dynamics are highly sensitive to shape. In particular, among elliptical particles, we find prolate particles tend to attract while oblate particles tend to repel, and these geometric details control the stability of polarized populations. We rationalize these behaviors through a far-field expansion of the boundary integral equations and its corresponding reduced-order model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究表面活性剂产生粒子在自生Marangon流驱动下的集体运动，在低雷诺数和低佩克莱特数下将非局部耦合化为粒子及边界上的积分方程，并通过数值模拟与远场约化模型揭示粒子形状对吸引、排斥及极化群体稳定性的控制作用。
AI.motivation: 表面活性剂产生粒子沿黏性流体表面运动时，其运动与整个流体表面的Marangon应力及体相流动非局部耦合，给建模、计算和许多粒子系统的粗粒化带来挑战；本文旨在建立可计算的约化框架并理解其集体动力学。
AI.method: 在低雷诺数和低佩克莱特数极限下，将非局部效应约化为仅支撑在粒子及其边界上的积分方程组；采用定制的谱方法进行数值模拟；并通过边界积分方程的远场展开及相应的降阶模型解释观察到的行为。
AI.result: 数值模拟表明集体动力学对粒子形状高度敏感：在椭圆粒子中，长椭球粒子倾向于相互吸引，扁椭球粒子倾向于相互排斥，这些几何细节控制极化群体的稳定性；远场展开和降阶模型为这些行为提供了合理解释。
AI.conclusion: 该积分方程 formulation 既便于计算，也为许多粒子系统的系统粗粒化提供了框架；粒子几何形状是决定自生Marangon流驱动集体动力学和极化群体稳定性的关键因素，远场约化模型可解释相关机制。摘要未提供具体定量参数或实验验证细节。

title: Instability of layered two-phase flow in a vertical plane channel
summary: The equilibrium two-phase flows in a vertical plane channel are explored by adopting an approximate Boussinesq-like model. The class of stationary parallel flows examined in this paper features three-layer configurations in which the central core is less dense than the peripheral layers. Such flows are considered purely buoyant, induced by the density difference between the phases. The simplified scheme leads to a formulation where the parameters driving the transition to linear instability of the equilibrium flow are the Archimedes number and the dimensionless positions of the interfaces between the phases. The analysis takes into consideration symmetric and asymmetric flows, including, as special cases, also two-layer configurations with one phase close to the left-hand boundary wall and the other close to the right-hand wall. In particular, the completely antisymmetric flow, where the equilibrium velocity profile is an odd function of the transverse coordinate, shows up as the least stable configuration among those examined in this study.

AI.tldr: 采用近似Boussinesq类模型研究竖直平面通道中由密度差驱动的三层平衡两相平行流，并以Archimedes数和无量纲界面位置分析其线性稳定性；完全反对称流最不稳定。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确说明研究动机；所述工作聚焦于中心层密度低于外围层的三层平衡两相流，并考察此类纯浮力流的线性稳定性。
AI.method: 采用近似Boussinesq类模型，研究竖直平面通道内的定常平行流，重点为三层构型，其中中心核心密度低于外围层；该流动被视为由相间密度差驱动的纯浮力流。简化方案把平衡流发生线性不稳定的驱动参数归结为Archimedes数与相界面的无量纲位置，并分析对称与非对称流，包括一相靠近左壁、另一相靠近右壁的两层特例。
AI.result: 分析表明，线性不稳定转变由Archimedes数和无量纲界面位置控制；在所考察的构型中，平衡速度剖面为横向坐标奇函数的完全反对称流是最不稳定的配置。摘要未给出临界参数的定量数值。
AI.conclusion: 三层浮力驱动的平衡两相平行流的线性稳定性可由Archimedes数与界面位置刻画；完全反对称构型稳定性最低。摘要未提供定量阈值、实验验证或非线性演化结论。

title: A curvature-corrected port-Hamiltonian reduced-order model for dissipative sloshing with contact-line hysteresis in low-gravity tanks
summary: A physics-based reduced-order model unifies curved-meniscus inertia, viscous losses and nonsmooth contact-line stick-slip in a passive port-Hamiltonian formulation for lateral sloshing in cylindrical tanks. Dirichlet-Neumann and Jacobi operators describe inertia and restoring forces, while a convex potential combines bulk, Stokes-layer and contact-line dissipation. Analytical propagation between stick-slip events supports faster-than-real-time simulation of coupled spacecraft translation and sloshing. The viscous closure agrees within 5% with a reference Stokes calculation, and the model reproduces the Henderson-Miles modal measurements and the Cocciaro hysteretic decay. Across 42 drop-tower and ground measurements, curvature correction reduces the root-mean-square frequency error from 24 to 4%. For flight and ground tests from the Middeck 0-Gravity Dynamics Experiment (MODE), frequency errors range from 0.9 to 7.1%, while ideal contact lines underestimate the damping ratios from the MODE fits by 38-87%. One hysteresis width, calibrated on the lowest orbital water excitation, predicts higher orbital excitations and the ground test with normalised force errors of 11-35%, against 149-208% for an ideal pinned line. It predicts 8.5% resonance softening against 7.3% measured, which the tested one-parameter damping laws miss. Uncertain wetting and remaining response discrepancies motivate damping ranges in spacecraft control analyses.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个面向圆柱储箱横向晃动的物理降阶模型，将弯曲液面惯性、黏性损失和非光滑接触线黏滑统一到被动端口哈密顿框架中，并用于航天器平动与晃动的耦合仿真。模型经多组解析、实验、落塔、地面和MODE飞行数据校验，显示曲率修正和单一滞后宽度可显著改善频率、阻尼与滞后预测，但润湿不确定性仍要求控制分析采用阻尼范围。
AI.motivation: 摘要未单列研究动机；其动因是建立一个可统一描述弯曲液面惯性、黏性耗散和接触线黏滑的物理降阶模型，以支持圆柱储箱横向晃动及航天器平动-晃动耦合的快速仿真，并提高对频率、阻尼和滞回行为的预测能力。
AI.method: 采用被动端口哈密顿降阶建模：以Dirichlet-Neumann算子和Jacobi算子描述惯性与恢复力，用凸势函数组合体相、Stokes层和接触线耗散，并纳入非光滑接触线黏滑；在黏滑事件之间进行解析传播，从而支持快于实时的航天器平动与晃动耦合仿真。
AI.result: 黏性闭合与参考Stokes计算相差5%以内；模型复现Henderson-Miles模态测量和Cocciaro滞回衰减。42组落塔与地面测量中，曲率修正将频率均方根误差从24%降至4%。MODE飞行与地面试验频率误差为0.9%-7.1%，理想接触线将MODE拟合阻尼比低估38%-87%。以最低轨道水激励标定的单一滞后宽度可预测更高轨道激励和地面试验，归一化力误差为11%-35%，而理想钉扎接触线为149%-208%；其预测共振软化8.5%，实测为7.3%，所测试的单参数阻尼律未捕捉该效应。
